name: Pushpa Impossible
description: Pushpa Impossible is the story about a feisty middle-aged woman having studied until grade 9 in a Gujarati medium school and going back to school at the age of 44! She is boisterous, uncouth, impulsive, hardworking and an endearingly loveable mother of three children. She is Pushpa Patel hailing from a small town Patan in Gujarat and now residing at Bapodra Chawl in Mumbai. The show is a peek into her day-to-day struggles, her small victories, her Juggad, her shortcomings, and her constant pursuit of living a good life while struggling as a full-time mother and part-time businesswoman. The show is an autobiography of a mother, who decides to go back to school and change her life by impacting many lives!

videos.title: Meeting The Principal
videos.overview: Pushpa has a big breakfast order to make and finds out that the gas supply has been shut. She does what she can and completes the order but ends up paying a fine for it to Bapodara. Later in the day, she goes to meet Chirag’s college principal as she was called there but finds out that Chirag has brought somebody else as his father.

videos.title: Pushpa's Promise
videos.overview: Sonal calls Pushpa to her house to cook for the party as she is worried about the food for her guests. Though Pushpa recommends somebody else but ends up going there to fulfil her promise. Meanwhile, Rashi doesn't do well in her school.

videos.title: Ladki Wale Aa Rahe
videos.overview: Dipti finds out that Pushpa has left without taking money. Pushpa on the other hand is excited to welcome Dipti’s parents home. While she is busy with all the preps she gets tempted to play the last over of cricket as there is still some time for Dipti’s family to arrive.

videos.title: Rashi's Results
videos.overview: Deepti's parents discourage her from getting married to a family that can't keep up with them financially. Meanwhile, Pushpa goes to Rashi's school to discuss Rashi's results.

videos.title: Pushpa Apologises
videos.overview: Pushpa goes to meet Deepti in the middle of the night and apologises for what had happened the day before. Meanwhile, Chirag gets in trouble with his friends due to some money-related issues. Will Deepti forgive Pushpa?

videos.title: Chirag's Gambling Habit
videos.overview: Pushpa finds out about Chirag's gambling habit and scolds him. She makes it clear that she will forgive him this time but she expects him to repay her by himself. Later, Pushpa and Ashwin go to meet Deepti's family.

videos.title: Pushpa's Bangles
videos.overview: Chirag is worried about returning the money that he lost in gambling and thinks of selling Pushpa's bangles to return the money. Meanwhile, Pushpa gives her bangles to Ashwin for his marriage. How will Chirag repay the money?

videos.title: Engagement Ceremony
videos.overview: It's Deepti and Ashwin's engagement ceremony in the chawl and Pushpa organizes an entertaining show for the guests. Will the ceremony go as planned?

videos.title: Chirag's Police Case
videos.overview: After coming to know about Chirag's police case, Deepti's parents wonder if they made the right decision by allowing her to marry Ashwin. Meanwhile, Chirag promises Pushpa that he had nothing to do with the leak of the question papers.

videos.title: Kya Chirag Nirdosh Hai?
videos.overview: The Police reach the Chawl to give a verdict on Chirag's case. Is Chirag innocent or guilty?

videos.title: Pushpa Ka Safety Net
videos.overview: Pushpa refuses Deepti's help to pay Rashi's coaching class fees. What route will she take for the sake of her children?

videos.title: Pani Ke Liye Ladai
videos.overview: Pushpa delivers the money required to Rashi's coaching classes on time. She later takes the fight to the Assistant Commissioner for the shortage of water at their chawl.

videos.title: Chawl Mein Adjust
videos.overview: Pushpa talks to Rashi about focusing on her future and staying away from boys. Meanwhile, Deepti's parents and Ashwin are worried about Deepti moving into the chawl and struggling to adjust there.

videos.title: Pushpa Makes It Right
videos.overview: Pushpa tries to find a part-time job to help her family with some extra income. She later visits the Assistant Commissioner to apologise for her behaviour. Will she succeed in solving the water crisis at the chawl?

videos.title: Ashwin Takes Up The Challenge
videos.overview: Ashwin steps up in the office meeting and promises to deliver the report in 3 days. Will he be able to deliver?

videos.title: Nanavati Ji Se Mulaqat
videos.overview: Rashi gets inspired by one of the trustees of the school board and Pushpa decides to meet him. Meanwhile, Ashwin is confident about his preparations for his presentation.

videos.title: Sab Kuch Pushpa Ki Galti?
videos.overview: Rashi is upset that Pushpa went to meet her Principal in private. Meanwhile, Ashwin accuses Pushpa of deleting his important files. Will he be able to present the report on time?

videos.title: Pushpa Ke Certificates
videos.overview: Pushpa feels nostalgic to visit her home town and meet her teacher. She gets her mark sheets and school leaving certificate with the hopes to continue her education.

videos.title: Pushpa's Admission
videos.overview: Deepti gets a promotion because of the presentation created by Ashwin. Meanwhile, Pushpa is delighted to get her old certificates and have a shot at going back to school.

videos.title: Meeting Ke Liye Late?

videos.overview: A huge commotion takes place outside Pushpa's chawl as everyone comes to know about her plans to continue her education. Will she be able to convince everyone?

videos.title: Meeting The Trustees
videos.overview: Pushpa meets the board and the trustees and puts her case forward. Will her dream of being educated be fulfilled?

videos.title: Ek Nayi Soch
videos.overview: Pushpa bonds with Sharan without knowing who he is. Will his decision get influenced because of this interaction?

videos.overview: Rashi fears the embarrassment she will face when Pushpa joins the same class. Pushpa can't contain her excitement about getting the opportunity to complete her education.

videos.title: School Ka Pehla Din

videos.overview: Pushpa gives up on her dream of being educated due to external pressure. Her sons are now determined to do whatever it takes to ensure that she returns to school.

videos.title: Negotiating With Rashi
videos.overview: Mr Nanavati takes in Pushpa's advice and negotiates with Rashi the way Pushpa had briefed him. Will he be able to crack a deal with her?

videos.title: Bapodara Crosses The Line
videos.overview: Bapodara accuses Chirag of stealing his shirt and then proceeds to insult Pushpa. Will Pushpa make it to school with all the obstacles on the way?

videos.title: Pita Hone Ka Farz
videos.overview: Chirag feels guilty for everything that happened to Munna. Sonal and Harish stop by Pushpa's house to discuss Dipti and Ashwin's wedding.

videos.title: Pushpa Begins Her Education
videos.overview: Bapodara feels insulted because of the slap he received in front of everyone in the chawl and starts plotting revenge. Meanwhile, Pushpa starts doing better in her class and becomes more proactive.

videos.title: Eviction Notice
videos.overview: Pushpa struggles in class due to the language barrier even though she knows the answers. Later, she receives a shocking eviction notice from Bapodara.

videos.title: Pushpa Keeps On Fighting
videos.overview: As the wedding day inches closer, Pushpa is put in a fix with the eviction notice. Deepti and Ashwin show trust in Pushpa to save their house. But will managing life, along with school and the wedding prove to be too much for Pushpa?

videos.title: Sharan Helps Pushpa
videos.overview: Sharan decides to help Pushpa in preparing for her test and motivates her to take small steps towards her success. Meanwhile, Bapodara continues to harass Pushpa and her family.

videos.title: The Legal Battle
videos.overview: Pushpa receives advice on how to fight her legal battles against Bapodara. Meanwhile, Nanavati tells Pushpa that her verbal knowledge is fine but she needs to work on her written skills.

videos.title: Koshish Karte Rehna Chahiye
videos.overview: Rashi tries to find a way to deal with Aryan at school. Chirag entrusts Prarthana to come through at the end and support the truth.

videos.title: Test Ki Taiyyari
videos.overview: Pushpa finds an ingenious way to study for her exam and make sure she passes in the limited amount of time given to her. Will her plan work?

videos.title: Bappa Pe Vishwas
videos.overview: Pushpa and Rashi get late for their test and leave home in a hurry. Meanwhile, Chirag tries to gather concrete evidence against Bapodara.

videos.title: Rashi Kaha Hai?
videos.overview: Pushpa struggles to find Rashi after discovering that she skipped her classes. Meanwhile, the lawyer informs Pushpa that their appeal for a stay order has been rejected by the court.

videos.title: Bapodara Ke Khilaaf Saboot
videos.overview: Pushpa and her lawyer try and think of ways to make their appeal stronger in court. Meanwhile, Rashi ends up at Aryan's party, where she feels out of place.

videos.title: Dubai Mein Naukri
videos.overview: Bhaskar suggests that Ashwin move to Dubai and secure his family's finances but Ashwin cites family and personal issues. Later, the family celebrates Asavri and Bhaskar's anniversary.

videos.title: The Results Are Out
videos.overview: Pushpa barely passes the examination and gets inspired to perform well in her future tests. With Rashi remaining silent about her worries, Pushpa finds another way to inspire her.

videos.title: Rishte Mein Nok Jhok
videos.overview: Deepti and Ashwin look at Asavri and Bhaskar and become hopeful about their marriage. Meanwhile, Aryan threatens Rashi and demands that she apologises to him.

videos.title: Susheela To The Rescue
videos.overview: Sharan gives Rashi some life lessons in his own cryptic way. Meanwhile, Susheela surprises Pushpa by handing her the property documents. How handy will these papers come in the case?

videos.title: Shaadi Ki Shopping
videos.overview: Susheela gets kicked out of the house by Bapodara and Pushpa holds herself responsible for this. Later, Pushpa and Ashwin go shopping with Deepti and her family for the wedding. Will Pushpa's financial constraints hold her back?

videos.title: Pushpa's Dilemma

videos.overview: Susheela's absence starts to bother Bapodara but he isn't ready to admit his mistake. Meanwhile, Rashi agrees to apologise to Aryan.

videos.title: Pushpa Ka Ikka
videos.overview: Chirag goes from home to home to record statements of all the residents in the chawl. Pushpa offers to give away her advantage in court if Bapodra apologises to Susheela and gets her back home.

videos.title: Rashi In Trouble
videos.overview: Rashi reaches Bandra, where Aryan had called her to come and apologise. Pushpa gets informed about this by Rashi's friends, and she rushes to the location. Will Pushpa miss her court date because of this?

videos.title: Rashi Ki Clip
videos.overview: Aryan circulates the clip where Rashi seems to be holding an alcoholic beverage. This creates controversy in school and Rashi gets called in to talk with the board members. Will Rashi's name get cleared?

videos.overview: Rashi is proven innocent and Pushpa feels extremely proud of her daughter. But will her decision to skip the court date haunt her in the future?

videos.title: Boss Ka Dabav
videos.overview: Ashwin finds out that his boss is Aryan's father. He gets pressured to ask Rashi to forgive Aryan. How will Ashwin react to this?

videos.title: Prarthana Ki Tasveer

videos.title: Damini Mehra Offers Help
videos.overview: As Damini and Pushpa meet again under strange circumstances, Damini offers to help Pushpa fight her case. How will Pushpa react to this?

videos.title: Pushpa Learns New Things
videos.overview: Pushpa takes Radha Tai's help and learns about the great reformists who shaped modern society and fought for women's rights.

videos.title: Ashwin's Decision
videos.overview: Ashwin takes a radical step and decides to move to Dubai with Bhaskar for some time. How will Pushpa react to this?

videos.title: Damini Fights Back
videos.overview: Damini makes some strong arguments against Bapodara in court and invites the person who made the contract for Bapodara 17 years ago, to the witness box.

videos.title: Adalat Ka Faisla
videos.overview: Damini puts forward all her arguments and makes a strong case for Pushpa. Will the court rule in favour of her?

videos.title: Chirag Ki Naukri
videos.overview: The family celebrates as Chirag gets a part-time job at the police station as a sketch artist. Meanwhile, Pushpa goes to the police station for Bapodara's bail.

videos.title: Judaai Ka Gum
videos.overview: Bapodara comes home after getting bailed out by Pushpa. Meanwhile, Ashwin is in a dilemma as he gets a job in Dubai.

videos.title: Rishton Mein Daraarein
videos.overview: Deepti's and Ashwin's relationship gets bitter after Ashwin considers moving to Dubai. Will their issues get resolved?

videos.title: Shadi Postponed?
videos.overview: Bhaskar leaves for Dubai, leaving everyone teary-eyed. Meanwhile, Deepti's Parents suggest postponing the wedding.

videos.title: Digital Records
videos.overview: Ashwin and Deepti make progress in their investigation and have a major breakthrough. Will they be able to prove their innocence?

videos.title: Family Lunch
videos.overview: Pushpa invites Deepti and her family for lunch as the family celebrates the couple. Meanwhile, Chirag goes to Bapodara's house as Chirag Gokhale, the sketch artist.

videos.title: Parents Ka Objection
videos.overview: The parents of the students object to Pushpa studying in the school. Even Mr Nanavati considers rusticating Pushpa to save the other students. Will Pushpa find a solution to this?

videos.title: Pushpa's Education in Danger
videos.overview: The parents object to Pushpa studying in the school and also demand that Aryan's suspension gets revoked. What will Pushpa do now?

videos.title: Pushpa's Fate
videos.overview: Mr Nanavati gets pressurised by the parents and the board to remove Pushpa from the school. Will he succumb to the pressure?

videos.title: Aakhri Ke Do Hafte
videos.overview: Nanavati Ji breaks the news to Pushpa that the trustees have decided to revoke her admission. What will she do now?

videos.title: Mock Papers
videos.overview: Pushpa struggles to prepare for her test, but Sharan provides her with all the material she needs. Will she ace her test?

videos.title: Mock Test Ka Result
videos.overview: Pushpa and Rashi attempt a mock test in preparation for the real test. Later, Rashi stands up for her mother in school.

videos.title: Surprise Party
videos.overview: Pushpa plans a surprise party for Mahendra on the terrace. Will everything go according to plan?

videos.title: Terrace Ki Confusion
videos.overview: Pushpa and Ashwin's plans coincide, which creates a huge confusion in the colony. Will things get resolved?

videos.title: Mock Fire Drill
videos.overview: Pushpa is surprised to see a mock fire drill in school and starts panicking. Later, she gets an order for laddoos from Dakshesh. Will she be able to deliver?

videos.title: Golu Returns
videos.overview: Golu returns to the colony, to everyone's relief. Later, Pushpa impresses her in-laws with her clear chain of thought regarding reforms in the education system.

videos.title: Pushpa Inspiring People
videos.overview: Deepti's mother speaks to her family about how Pushpa has inspired people to pursue their dreams and aspirations. Meanwhile, Bapodara opens up about his history with Pushpa's husband.

videos.title: Pushpa's Management Skills
videos.overview: It's the day of the test and time for Pushpa to prove herself to everyone who doubted her. Will Pushpa pass the test?

videos.overview: A bunch of students get food poisoning while attempting the exam, and Pushpa decides to miss the exam to help the kids. However, this selfless act puts Pushpa's future in jeopardy.

videos.overview: Everyone in the Chawl is excited for Chirag and his Art shop's opening. Will Bapodara create trouble, or will everything go as planned?

videos.title: Results Ka Din
videos.overview: It's the day that everyone has been eagerly waiting for. Will Pushpa and Rashi pass the test?

videos.overview: Rashi gets an assignment on the status of old-age homes in the city. Later, Chirag tricks Bapodara into buying one of his sketches.

videos.overview: Ashwin and Deepti's families are excited about planning their wedding, but they struggle to find a middle ground. Can this dispute be solved?

videos.title: Pushpa Ki Padhai Jaari Rahegi
videos.overview: The society members take Pushpa's side and volunteer to help her with her education. Meanwhile, the preparation for Ashwin and Deepti's marriage continues, as the couple considers doing a court marriage.

videos.overview: Sonal decides to redo Pushpa's house and change its aesthetics. Meanwhile, Chirag gets depressed as he struggles to complete the order and finish all the sketches.

videos.title: Khushiyon Ki Barsaat
videos.overview: Everything starts falling in place for Pushpa as Chirag gets a taste of success with his art assignments. Meanwhile, Mr Nanavati decides to give Pushpa a special project. Will Pushpa accept it?

videos.title: Pushpa's New Role
videos.overview: Pushpa prepares herself to take over the canteen responsibility in the school. Meanwhile, Aryan meets Pushpa in private and begs for forgiveness. Will Pushpa give him a second chance?

videos.title: Helping Aryan
videos.overview: Rashi isn't pleased about the fact that Pushpa is helping Aryan. Pushpa talks to Mr Nanavati about reconsidering Aryan's suspension. Will he agree?

videos.title: Police Complaint Against Pushpa
videos.overview: Aryan goes missing from his home, and his father threatens to file a police complaint against Pushpa. Meanwhile, Pushpa continues preparations for Ashwin's wedding.

videos.title: Aryan's Second Chance
videos.overview: Mr Nanavati finds Aryan and brings him to the police station. Meanwhile, Pushpa and the others motivate Neelima to stand up against her abusive husband.

videos.title: Ashwin's Soft Spot
videos.overview: Ashwin yells at Rashi for misbehaving with Pushpa. Meanwhile, Sonal leaves her home after getting into a fight with her husband and arrives at Pushpa's chawl.

videos.title: Rishton Ka Santulan
videos.overview: Sonal takes advice from Pushpa regarding her fight with her husband. Later, she gets attacked by Nilima's inebriated husband. How will she adapt to the life in the chawl?

videos.title: Chawl Ka Ecosystem
videos.overview: Sonal experiences the ecosystem that sustains life in the Chawl and gains immense respect for Pushpa for being able to study here. Meanwhile, Mr Nanavati tells Pushpa that she might get an opportunity to go to Canada.

videos.title: Pushpa's Return
videos.overview: Pushpa's return to school would mean that the school would receive a substantial grant. Will she come back?

videos.title: Pushpa Ki Shart
videos.overview: Pushpa agrees to rejoin the school only on the condition that she passes the test. Will Pushpa succeed this time?

videos.title: Ashwin's Aggression
videos.overview: Ashwin beats up two thugs who try to harass Deepti. Meanwhile, Pushpa begins her preparation for the upcoming test.

videos.title: Punya Tithi
videos.overview: Pushpa celebrates Dussehra with all the other members of the Chawl. Meanwhile, Pushpa's guru pays her a special visit.

videos.title: Dussehra Celebrations
videos.overview: It's a festive mood at the chawl as everyone prepares for Dussehra celebrations. But things take a sharp turn when Nilima's husband attacks her again in an inebriated state. Who will come to her rescue?

videos.title: Ramesh In ICU
videos.overview: Ramesh gets rushed to the hospital after being hit on the head by Nilima. Meanwhile, Bapodara blames Pushpa for everything and tries to stay away from the police investigation.

videos.title: Court Kachehri Ka Chakkar
videos.overview: Pushpa gets thrown a curveball because of the court case regarding Nilima's husband. Who will come out to support her during these tough times?

videos.title: Nilima's Case
videos.overview: Rashi starts to lose herself in the process of punishing Aryan. Pushpa continues preparing for the test while helping Nilima with her case.

videos.title: Pranav Returns
videos.overview: Radha Tai's son lands up at home with his wife, and he expects to be treated as if nothing has happened. Meanwhile, Deepti tries to convince her mother to give her statement in court.

videos.title: Chirag In Trouble
videos.overview: Pushpa writes her test and stops worrying about her results. Meanwhile, the police ask Nilima to stand in front of her husband after he gains consciousness.

videos.title: Pranav's Divorce
videos.overview: Radha Tai gets shocked to hear that Pranav has asked for a divorce from his wife. Meanwhile, Pushpa prepares herself to get her test results.

videos.title: Buri Sangat
videos.overview: Chirag gets upset that Pushpa didn't defend his father when Bapodara was insulting him and calling him a fraud. Meanwhile, Bapodara decides to send Prarthana away to stop her from meeting Chirag.

videos.overview: It's a festive mood in the Chawl as Pushpa and her neighbours celebrate Diwali. Meanwhile, Bapodara pays a visit to Ramesh at the hospital. What could be the reason behind this visit?

videos.title: Nilima Ki Sunwai

videos.title: Hostel Ya Pune?
videos.overview: Deepti's family thinks of ways to help Prarthana and stop Bapodara from toying with her life. Meanwhile, Radha Tai finds out that her granddaughter has been living in a hostel.

videos.overview: Pushpa and Nilima find bundles of cash hidden in a drawer and some notes referring to 'Seth Ji'. They also get suspicious when they hear about Bapodara checking on Ramesh in the hospital. What connection do they have?

videos.title: Chawl Mein Chor

videos.title: Dadi Ka Intezar
videos.overview: Bapodara gets convinced to keep Prarthana in Mumbai because of the scholarship. Meanwhile, Deepti and her family prepare for Dadi's arrival.

videos.title: Deepti Ki Dadi
videos.overview: Dadi arrives for Deepti's wedding. However, chaos ensues when Dadi finds out about Ashwin's background.

videos.title: Deepti Aur Ashwin Ki Kundali
videos.overview: Dadi wants to see Deepti and Ashwin's kundali, and she threatens to break off the wedding if their kundalis don't match. What will Pushpa do now?

videos.title: Kundali Ka Chakkar
videos.overview: Dadi arrives at the Chawl and gets off on the wrong foot with Pushpa. How will Pushpa meet Dadi's never-ending demands?

videos.overview: Ashwin and Deepti's family come together for the Sangeet ceremony. Meanwhile, two thieves plan to steal all the jewellery from Pushpa's house while everyone is busy with the program.

videos.title: Pushpa's Sangeet Performance
videos.overview: Pushpa puts on a dance performance for all the guests at the Sangeet. Later, the two thieves turn off the electricity supply to attempt to steal the jewellery. Will they be successful?

videos.title: Shaadi Mein Chori
videos.overview: Bhaskar surprises everyone and returns home for Ashwin's wedding. Meanwhile, Pushpa finds out that all the jewellery has been stolen from her house. What will Pushpa do now?

videos.title: Investigating The Stolen Jewellery
videos.overview: Pushpa tells Sonal about the stolen jewellery, and Sonal decides to help her. Meanwhile, Chirag aids the police to catch the thieves.

videos.title: Ashwin Ki Baraat
videos.overview: Bapodara finds out that jewellery has been stolen from Pushpa's house. Meanwhile, Ashwin's baarat leaves for the marriage hall.

videos.title: Daadi Ki Narazgi

videos.overview: Bapodara's Chawl faces the issue of water shortage the day after Ashwin and Deepti's wedding. Meanwhile, Versha devises a plan to get Radha Tai's signatures on the property papers.

videos.overview: The kids wonder if Dilip is feeling guilty for his sins. Ashwin warns Chirag and Rashi not to fall into Dilip's trap. Later, Pushpa finds out about Dilip's gift to Rashi. How will Pushpa react?

videos.title: Rashi Ka Jawab
videos.overview: Ashwin receives flowers from an unknown person. Chirag sketches his picture instead of Prarthana's fiancee in the portrait. Later, Pushpa sees Rashi returning the phone to Dilip.

videos.title: Pushpa's Advice To Chirag
videos.overview: Pushpa finds out about Chirag and Prarthana's feelings. Dilip meets Rashi in Pushpa's absence. Later, Pushpa asks Chirag to stay away from Prathana.

videos.title: Chirag Aur Prathana Ka Bhavishya
videos.overview: Radha Kaku advises Pushpa to take Chirag's side and speak to Susheela about it. Later, Dilip and Bapodara hold an emergency meeting in the society. What will be the meeting's agenda?

videos.title: Rashi Ka Dilip Par Vishwas
videos.overview: Susheela talks to Prarthana about Chirag. Pushpa gets scared when she realises Rashi is following Dilip's footsteps. Later, Prarthana asks his cousin to find out about Chriag's feelings.

videos.title: Pushpa Talks To Chirag
videos.overview: Dilip challenges Bapodara, while Rashi takes Dilip's side in front of everyone. Prarthana asks Chirag if he considers her more than a friend.

videos.title: Chirag In A Difficult Spot
videos.overview: Pushpa asks Susheela to not worry about Prarthana's marriage. Prarthana's cousin asks Chirag to fight for his love. What will he do?

videos.title: Pushpa Ke Ghar Par Dinner Party
videos.overview: Pushpa invites Bapodara and his family for dinner at her place. Prarthana tells Chirag that she is ready to fight for him. Later, Bapodara finds out that Prarthana was alone with Chirag. How will he react?

videos.title: Professional Touch Vs Personal Touch
videos.overview: Pushpa wants to keep Rashi away from Dilip while Dilip orders expensive continental food for Rashi's party. Later, Rashi calls Dilip to her party to thank him for the arrangements he made for her.

videos.title: Chirag Is Feeling Helpless
videos.overview: Ashwin and Dilip have a heated argument. Bapodara is busy with Prarthana's engagement preparations, while Sunny asks Deepti's help to postpone the engagement.

videos.title: Pushpa Ka Muh Tod Jawab
videos.overview: Chirag helps Bapodara catch the rat in his house. Mansi asks Ashwin to give Dilip one chance. Later, Pushpa breaks Dilip's expensive gift, and he raises his hand to hit Pushpa.

videos.title: Prarthana's Engagement Day
videos.overview: Deepti tells Ashwin that she sent Chirag to meet Prarthana. Prarthana's fiance sees Chirag and Prarthana together. What will happen now?

videos.title: Prarthana Hui Lapata
videos.overview: Jai sees Chirag and Prarthana hugging each other. Sushila tells Bapodara that Prarthana loves Chirag. Later, Pushpa gets shocked when she hears Prarthana has run away with Chirag.

videos.title: Engagement Cancel
videos.overview: Deepti and Ashwin tell Deepti's parents that Prarthana has run away with Chirag. Prarthana and Chirag show up with the police at her engagement. Later, Jai cancels his engagement with Prarthana.

videos.title: Chirag's Heartbreak
videos.overview: Pushpa and Deepti convince Jai to marry Prarthana. Chirag breaks out seeing Prarthana with Jai. Dilip asks Chirag to fight for his love. What will Chirag do?

videos.title: Dilip Ki Zidd
videos.overview: Prarthana tells Bapodara that she loves Chirag. Sushila apologizes to Pushpa for thinking wrong about her and Chirag. Later, Bapodara gets furious when he sees Dilip's wedding gift to Prarthana.

videos.title: Radha Kaku Ka Darr
videos.overview: Deepti's mother doesn't want Deepti and Ashwin to live in Pushpa's chawl. Radha Kaku falls and Pushpa gets worried for her because of her age. Later, Chirag tells Prarthana they will always be friends.

videos.title: Radha Kaku Ka Beta
videos.overview: Vikram agrees to stay with Radha Kaku. Prarthana gets emotional when Chirag tells Jai about Prarthana's likes and dislikes. Later, everyone celebrates Vikram, a new addition to Radha Kaku's family.

videos.title: Dilip Ka Naya Mohra
videos.overview: Ashwin tries to convince Pushpa to shift to a better society. Dilip plans to install solar electricity in the chawl. Later, Sunny tells Prarthana that if she sees an opportunity to get back together with Chirag then she shouldn't miss it.

videos.title: Rashi Ki Treat
videos.overview: Chawl people appreciate Dilip. Ashwin and Deepti go to Super Life Constructions to book a flat without knowing that the company could get blacklisted anytime. Later, Dilip arranges a special treat for Rashi and her friends.

videos.title: Naye Flat Ka Token
videos.overview: Pushpa tells Radha Kaku she can't leave the chawl. Prarthana tries to cut Chirag off from her life. Later, Ashwin asks Pushpa to give 15 lakh advance for the new flat. What will happen now?

videos.title: Tough Decision For Rashi
videos.overview: Rashi tells Deepti about how Dilip helped her treat her friends, and Pushpa overhears their conversation. Pushpa asks Rashi to choose between her and Dilip. Who will Rashi choose now?

videos.title: Pushpa Ke Pita Ki Akhri Nishani
videos.overview: Pushpa breaks down when she sees the keepsake broken, which was given to her by her father. Later, Pushpa misbehaves with Bapodara because she thinks he broke her father's keepsake.

videos.title: Pushpa Needs Proof
videos.overview: Pushpa apologizes to Bapodara for insulting him. Bapodara gets angry when he sees Chirag and Prarthana together. Later, Dilip lays down a plan to get in the good books of Chirag.

videos.title: Pushpa Ki Police Complaint
videos.overview: Bapodara finds Golu's phone and shows Dilip's video to Pushpa. Later, Dilip goes to the police station as Pushpa files a complaint against him. What will happen now?

videos.title: Ashwin Loses His Token Money
videos.overview: Ashwin finds out that the Super Life company's construction is illegal. Doctor tells Pushpa that she needs to find a donor for Mahendra's kidney transplant. Later, Rashi tells Pushpa that Dilip breaking Pushpa's father's keepsake is justified.

videos.title: Pushpa's Tough Decision
videos.overview: Pushpa gets emotional talking to Mahendra. Vasundhra gets angry with Dilip for investing a big amount of money without asking her. Later, Pushpa decides to donate her kidney to Mahendra.

videos.title: Dilip Ka Ehsaan
videos.overview: Pushpa tells everyone how Mahendra helped her in her time of need and wants to donate her kidney for Mahendra but Radha Kaku asks her not to do it. Later, Dilip gets Chirag and Ashwin out of jail.

videos.title: Golu Ki Imaandari Ki Dukan
videos.overview: Pushpa asks the chawl people to help run Mahendra's shop while he is in the hospital. Later, Mahendra tells Pushpa about his and Golu's past.

videos.title: Pushpa Waits For The Results
videos.overview: Pushpa tries to convince her family to let her donate her kidney to Mahendra. Pushpa and Rashi get scared, thinking about their exam result. Later, the doctor tells Pushpa her kidney tissue didn't match Mahendra's.

videos.title: Chawl Ki Asli Pehchan
videos.overview: Radha Kaku decides to donate her kidney to Mahendra. Later, Deepti's mother gives money to Ashwin to pay back his money lender. Pushpa is stressed about Mahendra's operation and her result.

videos.title: Pushpa Fails
videos.overview: Rashi scores well in her exams and Pushpa fails. A boy named Pakiya motivates Pushpa to try again. Later, Pushpa demands re-evaluation for her mathematics test. What will happen now?

videos.title: Pushpa Aur Rashi Ka Celebration
videos.overview: Dilip gets shocked when he sees Pushpa passed her exam. Later, Chirag asks Prarthana to meet him in private to confess his feelings. What will happen now?

videos.title: Papa Ki Sifarish
videos.overview: Pushpa gets worried when Rashi tells her about her dream college. She finds out about Chirag and Ashwin's arrest and scolds them. Later, Rashi tells Pushpa that her father is trying to be a better man.

videos.title: Laptop Chor
videos.overview: Pushpa tells Dilip that his kids are capable enough to understand his bad intentions. Chirag decides to tell Jai the truth about him and Prarthana. Meanwhile, Someone steals Dilip's laptop.

videos.title: Dilip Ke Office Mein Raid
videos.overview: Deepti tells Ashwin she sold her jewellery for money. Police raid Dilip's house and offices in Canada. Later, Prarthana tells Pushpa that Chirag is trying to break her engagement with Jai.

videos.title: Laptop Exchange
videos.overview: Pushpa doesn't believe that Pakiya has stolen Dilip's laptop. Pushpa scolds Chirag for trying to break off Prarthana's engagement. Later, Rashi brings home Dilip's laptop instead of Ashwin's laptop. What will happen now?

videos.title: Laptop Ki Khoj
videos.overview: Prarthana hides from Bapodara as he looks for her. Police come to Pushpa's chawl to search her house for Dilip's laptop. What will happen now?

videos.title: Chori Ka Karan
videos.overview: The police decide to arrest Pushpa for stealing Dilip's laptop, but Deepti tells the police about the misunderstanding. Later, Pushpa finds out why Pakiya stole Dilip's laptop.

videos.title: Sonal's Demand
videos.overview: Sonal is hellbent on making Ashwin and Deepti move out from the chawl. Deepti tries to make her understand but she isn't ready to listen.

videos.title: Sonal Ka Decision
videos.overview: Dilip talks to Bapodara about Prarthana and Chirag. Pushpa decides to apologise to Deepti's mother. Later, Deepti's mother says that she won't come to Bapodara Chawl again.

videos.title: Sabki Alag Problems
videos.overview: Prarthana's visa for London arrives which saddens her. Ashwin tells Deepti he doesn't want to take her mother's help. Later, Mahendra comes back home.

videos.title: Jai And Chirag's Fight
videos.overview: Jai finds out the truth about Prarthana and Chirag's relationship. Dilip talks to the principal of the college to which Rashi wants admission. Later, Jai fights with Chirag.

videos.title: Bapodara Loses Control
videos.overview: Deepti tries to convince Bapodara that Chirag is right for Prarthana. Chirag decides to become worthy of Prarthana. Will Bapodara ever approve of Prarthana and Chirag's relationship?

videos.title: Impossible Love Story
videos.overview: Bapodara refuses to accept Chirag and Prarthana's love. Pushpa wants to sponsor Pakiya's education for one whole year. Later, Ashwin gets angry at Sonal.

videos.title: Rashi Disregards Pushpa
videos.overview: Pushpa feels hurt after reading Rashi's diary. Rashi says Dilip did nothing with buying the seat for her favourite college. Later, Pushpa allows Rashi to stay with her father.

videos.title: Rashi Misses Pushpa
videos.overview: Rashi starts living with Dilip but is still upset because she misses Pushpa. Later, Dilip asks Rashi to go to her college in a rickshaw instead of his car.

videos.title: Bapodara Gets A Heart Attack
videos.overview: Pushpa convinces Deepti to celebrate her birthday. Rashi uses Dilip's laptop and finds Prarthana and Chirag's video in it. Later, Bapodara gets a heart attack. What will happen now?

videos.title: Pushpa Aur Rashi Ki Ek Cup Chai
videos.overview: Rashi wants to check Dilip's phone. Ashwin's mood is upset because of Deepti's mother. Later, Pushpa takes up a big order to buy a good gift for Deepti's birthday.

videos.title: Bapodara Ki Badhti Nafrat
videos.overview: Rashi's friends tell Pushpa how Dilip broke Prarthana and Jai's engagement. Dilip uses Rashi to get close to Chirag. Later, Pushpa asks Chirag to promise her that he would stay away from Prarthana.

videos.title: Prarthana Ka Picha
videos.overview: A man follows Prarthana. Rashi picks up Manasi's call on Dilip's laptop and finds out about the problem Vasundhara is in because of Dilip. Later, Dilip helps Chirag with his career.

videos.title: Chirag Ki Nayi Job
videos.overview: Pushpa finds out that Dilip helped Chirag get a job. Deepti helps Pushpa prepare her tiffin order. Meanwhile, Vasundhara decides to confront Dilip about his actions in Bapodara Chawl.

videos.title: Dilip's Priorities
videos.overview: Sonal doesn't like Deepti working with Pushpa. Sonal cancels Deepti's birthday party at her house. Later, Rashi overhears Dilip telling Vasundhara that she and Manasi are his top priorities. What will Rashi do now?

videos.title: Deepti Makes Up With Sonal
videos.overview: Dilip has to choose between Rashi and Vasundhara. Bapodara decides to catch Prarthana and Chirag red-handed. Later, Ashwin, Pushpa and Chirag give gifts to Deepti on her birthday.

videos.title: Sonal's Expensive Gift
videos.overview: Rashi comes to wish Deepti along with Dilip. Rashi insists that she will attend Deepti's birthday party only if she can bring Dilip along. Later, Sonal's words hurt Ashwin. How will Ashwin react?

videos.title: Ashwin's Wrong Move
videos.overview: Ashwin and Deepti get into a fight and Ashwin raises his hand at her. Pushpa throws Ashwin out of her house. What will happen now?

videos.title: Sonal Questions Deepti
videos.overview: Deepti's father tells Ashwin that domestic abuse is non-negotiable in a marriage. Rashi asks Ashwin to come to Dilip's house. Later, Sonal gets furious and asks Deepti to come back home with her.

videos.title: Sonal Ki Complaint
videos.overview: Sonal files a complaint against Ashwin. Ashwin talks to everyone and tries to find a way to make things right. Later, the police call Ashwin and Deepti to the police station.

videos.title: Rashi Asks Dilip To Apologize
videos.overview: Rashi tells Dilip to apologize to Pushpa as he claims to be regretful about his actions. Meanwhile, Ashwin tries talking to Sonal at her office.

videos.title: Rashi Doesnt Want To Choose
videos.overview: Dilip apologises to Pushpa in front of everyone and Pushpa accepts his apology. Rashi tells Dilip she wants to help him with Vasundhara's problem. Later, Rashi gets emotional and talks to Pushpa.

videos.title: Pushpa Ki Misaal
videos.overview: Mr Nanavati praises Pushpa in front of all the students for her dedication to her studies at Rashi's school. Afterwards, Pushpa clearly expresses to Ashwin that Deepti must forgive him before she can even consider forgiving him.

videos.title: Patan Connection
videos.overview: Pushpa endeavours to decipher the hidden significance behind the visions she has been experiencing regarding Patan and the craft she has been involved in since her childhood.

videos.title: Golu's Time To Shine
videos.overview: Pushpa sees some musicians in distress and decides to help them by introducing them to Golu. Will they be impressed with Golu's flute performance?

videos.title: Mumbai Mein Toofan
videos.overview: Rashi and Golu get ready for their respective performances and the cyclone hits Mumbai. Later, Rajesh Wagle helps Pushpa and Golu reach their destination.

videos.title: Logo Ki Madad
videos.overview: Golu impresses everyone with his performance while Ashwin helps a girl in need. Chirag helps Sushila get home safely. Later, Pushpa refuses to sit in Dilip's car.

videos.title: Rashi Is Worried For Dilip
videos.overview: Dilip faints and Ashwin brings him home. Rashi informs Vasundhara about what happened with Dilip. Later, Sushila begins to develop a liking for Chirag.

videos.title: Chirag's New Job
videos.overview: Chirag delivers food to people to earn money. Pushpa plays a confession game with Deepti. Later, Deepti's father talks to Pushpa about Deepti and Ashwin.

videos.title: Pushpa's Father's Janam Jayanti
videos.overview: Prarthana calls Deepti to ask about Chirag's health. Pushpa goes to attend an event which is honouring her father's work. Later, Prarthana secretly goes to meet Chirag.

videos.title: Deepti's Grandmother
videos.overview: Someone steals Pushpa's father's statue and replaces it with a fake one. Later, Deepti's grandmother comes to her house and sees Ashwin sleeping outside. What will she do now?

videos.title: Sonal In Bapodara Chawl
videos.overview: Deepti's grandmother must not find out about Deepti and Ashwin's fight. She asks about Rashi. Later, Deepti's parents go to Bapodara Chawl.

videos.title: Ashwin Aur Deepti Ki Majboori
videos.overview: Ashwin and Deepti have to stay together because of Deepti's grandmother. Pushpa and Masterji go out to find the artisan who can fix Pushpa's handloom. Later, Deepti's grandmother keeps a pooja for Ashwin and Deepti.

videos.title: Pushpa's Childhood Friend
videos.overview: Bapodara decides to expose Ashwin in front of Deepti's grandmother. Pushpa and Masterji reach the house of the person who makes handloom and Pushpa asks him to help her. Later, Pushpa sees her father's statue in the handloom maker's house.

videos.title: Pushpa's Father's Death
videos.overview: Deepti's grandmother asks Bapodara what he wanted to tell her about Ashwin and Deepti. Juggal tells Pushpa a secret that he had kept for many years. Later, Ashwin apologizes to Deepti.

videos.title: Lalach Aur Vichar
videos.overview: Juggal tells Pushpa what happened between her father and Viren's father. Rashi misses Pushpa. Meanwhile, Pushpa feels bad when she learns the truth about her father's death.

videos.title: Dilip Is Unwell
videos.overview: Manasi tells Dilip that her mother went to jail because of him and Rashi overhears everything. Sonal asks Deepti to come back home with her. Later, Pushpa sees Viren mistreating his driver and gets furious.

videos.title: Pushpa Ka Aaroopi
videos.overview: Pushpa confronts Viren and blames him for her father's death. Deepti's grandmother wants to taste the barbeque dish that Deepti and Ashwin have made together. Later, Juggal goes to talk to Viren.

videos.title: Pushpa Back In Mumbai
videos.overview: Pushpa acts surprised when Deepti tells her that her grandmother gave them a surprise visit. Later, Rashi tells Pushpa everything that has been going on with Dilip.

videos.title: Pushpa Wants To Join College
videos.overview: Viren Setalwad is the trustee of the college which Pushpa wants to join. Rashi realises that someone else deserves the seat Dilip bought for her in her dream college. Meanwhile, Vasundhara plans to go back to India.

videos.title: Deepti's Grandmother's Acting
videos.overview: Pushpa pushes Bapodara to tell the truth to Deepti's grandmother. Later, Deepti's grandmother creates a scene at Bapodara Chawl when Bapodara tells her about Ashwin and Deepti. What will happen now?

videos.title: Rashi Does The Right Thing
videos.overview: Pushpa shares her feelings with her father. Rashi gives her seat to the student who she thinks deserves it more. Later, Orbit College's principal meets Pushpa at the Bapodara chawl where Pushpa shows her her handloom.

videos.title: Bapodara Ka Badla
videos.overview: Deepti and Ashwin go out on a date but Ashwin still feels guilty for his actions. Bapodara sends Prarthana and Chirag's video to Vasundhara. Later, Deepti's grandmother and Pushpa go to Sonal's house.

videos.title: Dilip Ka Asli Chehra
videos.overview: Sonal realises her mistake and apologises to Deepti. Bapodara tries to provoke Dilip to show his real face to the world. Later, Dilip's anger takes over and Rashi gets scared of Dilip's reactions.

videos.title: Dilip Ka Asli Chehra
videos.overview: Pushpa asks Viren to help her get into Orbit College. Rashi sees a glimpse of Dilip's real face. Later, Dilip and Bapodara get into a fight.

videos.title: Dilip's Plan To Destroy Bapodara Chawl
videos.overview: Bapodara wants to see Dilip behind bars, but Pushpa worries that Dilip will destroy the Bapodara Chawl. Rashi tells Pushpa that Dilip is planning something big and dangerous. What is he planning?

videos.title: Dilip Is Finished
videos.overview: Dilip misbehaves with Rashi and Vasundhara stops him. Later, the Canadian government seals Dilip's companies, properties and bank accounts and he gets arrested. What will Dilip do now?

videos.title: Dilip Ke Jaane Ki Khushi
videos.overview: Rashi apologises to Pushpa for not listening to her. Pushpa tells her family that she is happy that Dilip is gone. Later, Ashwin wants to earn money so that Deepti would be proud of him.

videos.title: Pushpa Ka Unique Design
videos.overview: Pushpa shows the dress she made for Kalavati to her teachers. Ashwin apologizes to Sonal and tells her he wants to do something of his own. Later, Pushpa forgets Kalavati's dress in college.

videos.title: Golu Ki Maa
videos.overview: Pushpa, Mahendra and Golu go for dinner at Golu's teacher's place. Sushila tries to talk to Bapodara about Chirag and Prarthana. Later, Reena calls Ashwin and tells him about a job offer.

videos.title: Viren Steals Pushpa’s Design
videos.overview: Viren tells Pushpa she can't use the design she created as he owns it. Deepti has confidence that Ashwin will achieve something great. Later, Ashwin gets an interview with a very big company.

videos.title: Pushpa Ke Liye Nyay
videos.overview: Kalavati asks Pushpa for her dress. Pushpa's family tries to find clues to prove that the design belongs to Pushpa and not Viren. Later, Pushpa and her family decide to confront Viren. What will happen now?

videos.title: Pushpa Ke Kaam Ki Tareef
videos.overview: Pushpa and her family prove that the design belongs to Pushpa. Later, Pushpa gives Kalavati her dress and Kalavati appreciates Pushpa's work and gives her more work.

videos.title: Asawari's Pregnancy
videos.overview: The doctor tells Asawari's delivery has complications while Viren prepares to defeat Pushpa. Later, Golu gets ready to go to Switzerland while Ashwin goes for his interview.

videos.title: Twipple Ka Zamana
videos.overview: Pushpa tells Kalavati that she can't take orders for so many dresses but Kalavati encourages her because she thinks Pushpa is talented. Ashwin tries to get one more chance at the interview he missed. Later, Viren thinks of a plan to keep an eye on Pushpa.

videos.title: Pushpa Ki Parvarish
videos.overview: Chirag gets the opportunity to work as an illustrator at a news organisation. Meanwhile, Viren sends some students to Pushpa's house to help prepare the order. What is Viren planning?

videos.title: Doosra Setalvad
videos.overview: Ashwin gets a job while Pushpa's classmates tell her that Viren has sent them to help her in weaving the dresses. Later, Sonal tells Pushpa she needs time to heal.

videos.title: Naye Business Ka Budget
videos.overview: Juggal Setalwad doesn't want Pushpa to go against Viren and decides not to get involved. Later, Viren thinks Pushpa is stealing his customers from him while Pushpa talks to Bapodara about renting Dilip's flat.

videos.title: Paiso Ka Juggad
videos.overview: Ashwin finds out that Reena is his boss' daughter while Pushpa decides to take a loan. An MLA asks Bapodara to run for the Nagarpalika election. Later, Viren asks Pushpa to join hands with him.

videos.title: Naye Flat Ki Chaabi
videos.overview: Pushpa becomes more confident when she finds out that Viren considers her a threat. Rashi starts getting affected by trolls on her account. Meanwhile, Pushpa decides to take Kalavati's help. Will she get the help she needs?

videos.title: Juggal In Mumbai
videos.overview: Pushpa tells her family how she managed the money to buy Dilip's flat and finds out that Juggal is in Mumbai. Later, Pushpa tells Juggal she needs his help.

videos.title: One Thing At A Time
videos.overview: Pushpa motivates Sushila. Sonal gives very valuable advice to Pushpa. Later, Chirag's boss motivates him while one of Rashi's followers on social media stalks her.

videos.title: Bapuji Ka Sapna
videos.overview: Pushpa tells her family that she wants to stop her tiffin business. Prarthana makes a survey form for Bapodara. Later, Ashwin gets an opportunity to prove himself in his new office.

videos.title: Bapodara In Demand
videos.overview: Juggal is worried about Pushpa. Ashwin asks Deepti to help him with his new project while Chirag decides to do a story on Bapodara. Later, Rashi gets another scary message from her stalker.

videos.title: Pushpa Is Kidnapped
videos.overview: Rashi's stalker keeps sending her scary messages. Pushpa gets ready to go to Patan. Later, Chandrika and Pushpa get kidnapped. Who kidnapped them?

videos.title: Juggal The Kidnapper
videos.overview: Pushpa finds out that Juggal kidnapped her, Ramila, Kusum and Chandrika. Ashwin shows his presentation to his boss. Later, Pushpa wants to defeat Viren at all costs. Will Juggal support her?

videos.title: Brave Women
videos.overview: Juggal warns Pushpa and her team. Golu's teacher, Ayushi, wants to adopt Golu. Later, The women in Pushpa's team say they are ready to go against Viren and stand up for themselves.

videos.title: Viren Ka Vaar
videos.overview: Viren decides to invite Pushpa to his Janmashtami event while Chirag and Susheela plan Janmashtami in Bapodara Chawl. Later, a few dresses get stolen, and three women from Pushpa's team get blamed.

videos.title: Baazi Palat Gayi
videos.overview: Juggal tells Pushpa that Viren has framed the three women who supported her. Gauri blames Pushpa for whatever wrong happened to the three innocent women. Later, Bapodara doesn't believe his eyes when he sees Susheela getting all the arrangements done on zero budget.

videos.title: Doosre Setalwad Ka Vaar
videos.overview: Pushpa goes to Juggal to ask for his help and they go to the police station together. The police get a tip that the clothes that were stolen might be at Viren's workshop. What will happen now?

videos.title: Viren Ka Invitation
videos.overview: Viren takes back his complaint and apologizes to the three innocent women. Deepti finds out that someone is stalking Rashi. Viren invites Pushpa to his Janmashtami celebration. What is Viren planning?

videos.title: Janmashthami Ka Din
videos.overview: Juggal warns Pushpa because he thinks Viren is up to something. Susheela's set-up for Janmashthami is appreciated by everyone while Rashi's stalker clicks her pictures.

videos.title: Rashi Takes Action
videos.overview: Rashi goes to the police station along with Ashwin to file a complaint against her stalker. Later, Indu backs out from the play and Viren asks Pushpa to take her place as Yashodha. What will happen now?

videos.title: Pushpa's Injured Hands
videos.overview: Pushpa's hands get severely injured. Golu's teacher tells Mahendra she wants to adopt Golu while the doctor tells Pushpa she can't work on the handloom until her hands are healed. What will happen now?

videos.title: Chuppi Kamzori Nahi Hai
videos.overview: Juggal calls the police to find out who is responsible for hurting Pushpa while Gaurav tells his wife to forget about her past. Later, Pushpa decides to go back to Mumbai. What will happen next?

videos.title: Chirag Ke Iraade
videos.overview: MLA Prabhakar Jagtap arrives at the Bapodara Chawl as the chief guest at the Janmashtami event. Later, Bapodara slaps Chirag for ruining his dreams of becoming a politician. What will happen now?

videos.title: Viren Vs. Juggal
videos.overview: Pushpa tells her family what Viren did to her. Later, Juggal threatens the person who helped Viren in hurting Pushpa and takes him to the police station. What will happen now?

videos.title: Pushpa Kuch Bhi Kar Sakti Hai
videos.overview: Juggal tells Viren that this time he won't back down. Mahendra tells Pushpa that Golu's teacher, Ayushi spoke to him about adopting Golu. Later, Viren decides to give Pushpa's seat to another student. Is Pushpa dropping out of college?

videos.title: Golu Ki Maa
videos.overview: Pushpa tells Radha Kaku that Golu is not Mahendra's real son. Golu sees his picture from childhood in Ayushi's room. Later, Rashi tries to catch her stalker. Will she be successful?

videos.title: Juggal's Birthday
videos.overview: Rashi's stalker tricks her once again. Pushpa finds out that Golu is Ayushi's son while Juggal remembers the reason he doesn't celebrate his birthday. What is the reason?

videos.title: Viren Aur Juggal Ki Maa
videos.overview: Pushpa is worried about Mahendra and Golu. Pushpa tells Viren that she is not going to drop out of the college. Later, Juggal decides to go to Mumbai to help Pushpa while Viren remembers his painful past.

videos.title: Juggal Gets Kidnapped
videos.overview: Susheela offers to help Pushpa. Pushpa finds out that Juggal is coming to Mumbai while Viren gets him kidnapped. When will Pushpa find out that Juggal is in trouble?

videos.title: Juggal Ki Missing Report
